name: Tongshun Real Estate
aliases: 大连统顺房地产开发有限公司
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of Dalian Yingbo in the 2026 CSL season, identified by Tencent News (2026-03-17) as Dalian Tongshun Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (大连统顺房地产开发有限公司). Ownership not yet sourced: Chinese corporate registries (qcc, tianyancha, qizhidao) could not be opened from the research environment. Press context (Soccer News via Tencent, 2025-09-15): the club's investor Dalian Tongshun Construction Development Group, chaired by Wang Kui (also the club's chairman), moved from construction into property development in 2024; a source tying this real-estate entity to that group was not found.
